title: imap: IDLE command handler (RFC 2177)
description: Add IDLE to crates/imap/src/commands/idle.rs. IDLE allows server to push new message notifications without client polling. Algorithm: (1) require Selected state; (2) receive IdleCommandReceived(tag); (3) call server.idle_accept() (sends '+ idling'); (4) enter idle loop: tokio::select\! { new_articles = poll_new_articles_timer(30s) => { if any new articles since last EXISTS: compute new count, send enqueue_data(Data::Exists(count)) }, done = server.next() => break on IdleDoneReceived }; (5) send tagged OK; return to normal dispatch. poll_new_articles_timer: every 30s, call ArticleNumberStore::group_range() and compare to cached EXISTS count from SELECT; if higher, send EXISTS update. Defensive: session timeout still applies; DONE received -> exit cleanly.
